sph_interpretive_translation: Those whose sovereignty has been usurped, those unjustly punished by authority, and those whose rights have been denied due to conflict — along with ascetics, the poor, children, the elderly, women, and the injured — are not bound by conventional obligations of repayment or allegiance.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derivative of Dharma, not personal dominion.
Causation arises from disruption of svadharma, not from social position.
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with existential integrity, not economic or political status.
Restoration logic prioritizes re-alignment with cosmic order over contractual obligation.
Consciousness alignment supersedes external validation of duty.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual's sovereignty is violated THEN all claims of debt or fealty originating from that violation are null.
IF a person is punished without alignment to Dharma THEN their karmic and civic liability is suspended until restoration occurs.
IF a subject belongs to a vulnerable class (vrati, daridra, bala, vṛddha, strī, rugṇa) THEN default assumptions of capacity are void.
IF dharma-adhikaraṇa shows misalignment in ruling THEN prior rulings under that authority are subject to review and nullification.
IF consciousness integrity is compromised THEN legal obligation shifts to restoring that integrity before enforcing compliance.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, when sovereignty has been unlawfully seized or justice perverted by misuse of power, the aggrieved party stands absolved of reciprocal duties. The court must recognize pre-existing dharmic entitlement over procedural formalities.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that suffering caused by adharmic authority disrupts natural causality (anupūrvaśaḥ). Thus, obligation cannot arise from such distortion. Responsibility lies only where consciousness remains unbroken; hence, no punitive consequence ensues — only realignment toward svadharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-establishment of sovereign entitlement through public declaration and ritual restitution.
Suspension of all legal claims against the affected until full dharmic reintegration is achieved.
Deployment of Nyaya-sevaks to restore material, emotional, and spiritual equilibrium.
Mandatory completion process for authorities who acted beyond dharma-vākya.
Initiation of prāyaścitta vidhi for communities where such violations occurred en masse.
final_declaration: This law flows solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Sanatana Dharma. Justice herein restores Dharma, not vengeance. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. All else follows.
